name: Email flows
summary: Runs a retailer's email flows in Klaviyo: reads how each flow performs, opens a sprint on the weakest live flow under target, and queues the switch to live for each replacement the owner has marked ready. Crons read and record; a person approves every switch to live.

all.evidence: 2 of 5 retail discovery calls describe how they run email flows; every step they name is done by hand

covered_by.flow-build: skill (built as a draft in Klaviyo)
covered_by.optimise: review (sprint on the weakest live flow)

crons.name: performance
crons.summary: Read every flow and its results over the timeframe into the scorecard. Reads only (21:00 UTC is 7 or 8 am in eastern Australia).

crons.name: review
crons.summary: Open one sprint on the weakest live flow under target that has none. Records only.

crons.name: go-live
crons.summary: Queue the switch to live for each draft flow the owner has marked ready. Queues only.

draft_ops_note: Reads only, and a report query. query_flow_values is a POST that the spec marks as a write, so the deploy needs KIT_ALLOW_WRITES=1 for it; it changes nothing in Klaviyo.

klaviyo.covers: flow list, 30 day flow results, actions inside a flow (reads), and the switch to live (queued for approval)

gaps: Mailchimp (automations, campaign reports, send and schedule) and Shopify (marketing events, Flow features) are mapped but have no adapter yet. A client on either needs its adapter before these crons read it.
Writing message copy and templates into a flow (create_template, update_flow_action) is not built. It changes what customers receive, so it needs its own review before it becomes a cron.
Nothing records a replacement as ready yet. The go-live cron reads the store's ready entries, and a runtime helper in core (not this folder) is needed to mark one from the CRM shell.

Segment building, test sends and list hygiene are not built. The retail calls do not describe test sends or an approval step inside Klaviyo, and the fetched Klaviyo help pages do not cover them either.
The Klaviyo adapter is spec-only: its platform status is spec and it has never run against a real account. Confirm the read and the live switch in a live account before go-live.

evidence.calls: 2 of 5 retail discovery calls describe how they run email flows (a biohacking and sleep products D2C business): about 90 days to rewrite all flows at two emails a week, with the owner exporting the numbers and checking them against benchmarks each day
evidence.platforms: Klaviyo, Mailchimp and Shopify help pages mapped step by step; Klaviyo is the only one with an adapter in this build
